messages:
Tyler: fyi I opened a PR to change overlay secret wiring — moving from SSM paths to SecretManager for staging/prod. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/2345
Maria: quick skim — looks fine overall. main concern is TF SA permissions for secret access.
Tyler: added iam binding in the PR, snippet included:```hcl
resource "google_secret_manager_secret_iam_binding" "tf" {
  secret_id = var.secret_id
  role      = "roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor"
  members   = ["serviceAccount:infra-tf@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]
}
```
Alex: nit: add explicit depends_on for the binding so TF doesn't race when creating secret + binding.
Sam: do we rotate the KMS key as part of this? we should avoid breaking replication.
Tyler: KMS rotation is separate (handled by key admin). PR references existing key via `var.kms_key`. replication kept as user_managed.
Jen: how does this affect release gating? our prod overlay gating requires manual approval and overlay diff check.
infra-bot: release policy reminder: prod overlay changes require 2 infra approvals + successful `kustomize build overlays/prod | kubectl --dry-run=client apply -f -` in CI.
Maria: can we add a CI lint that flags changes moving secret backends (ssm -> secretmanager) so it's not accidental?
Tyler: I added a terraform plan job to CI for staging/prod, but the lint rule for backend migration is still manual. open to suggestions for automation.
Alex: we could add a simple grep step in CI: compare `plan` output for occurrences of `aws_ssm_parameter` / `google_ssm` -> flag. cheap and effective.
Sam: for safety, propose migration path: 1) create new secret entries in SecretManager, 2) update staging overlay to point to new paths, 3) run canary traffic, 4) promote to prod. no automatic fallback to old path.
Tyler: timeline: merge staging changes today, run canary for 24h, prod flip next week.
Jen: please add an entry in the rollout doc and @mention me when staging is green. I'll gate prod. :thumbsup: 
Tyler: done — added rollout steps in the PR description and the runbook. pinging @jen when CI passes.
infra-bot: ci: terraform-plan-staging passed (2026-03-10T15:12:03Z). kustomize dry-run also passed.
Alex: LGTM after adding depends_on and small comment about the variable name (use `secret_manager_id` vs `secret_id`).
Maria: +1 from me after IAM check.
Sam: I'll monitor canary metrics (latency, error-rate) and post a short report in #incidents.
Tyler: thanks all — merging staging now once CI completes. will not touch prod until @jen approves.
Jen: thanks, will review prod PR next week.
Tyler: tagging this thread in the PR so reviewers have context.
Alex: one last reminder: update the secrets inventory page with new SecretManager ARNs.
Tyler: noted — will update the doc after merge.
infra-bot: checklist update: added 'update-secrets-inventory' to PR tasks.
